items.prompt: An interface says only price:number. What would you clarify before using it to calculate cash?
items.explanation: Use the rubric to compare your reasoning. This open response is saved for self-review, not automatically judged for semantic correctness.
items.modelAnswer: Clarify the currency and scale, allowed range, decimal precision, missing/invalid input rules, and any conversion or rounding policy before multiplying by quantity.

criteria.text: Names allowed values and invalid/missing input handling.
